title: [spec] Retire three zero-reader UI keys per maintainer ruling: PageHeaderProps.icon, PageCardProps.actions, RecordDetailsProps.layout (objectui#3829 / objectui#3818)
body:
Maintainer ruling 2026-08-09 (decision-inbox round, 「全部接受」): objectui#3829 ruled route (c) — retire `PageHeaderProps.icon` and `PageCardProps.actions` upstream; objectui#3818 ruled the removal direction — retire `RecordDetailsProps.layout`. All three are spec-declared keys with **zero renderer read points** measured in objectui (see those cards for the full evidence), making them the ADR-0049 declared-but-unenforced shape on the platform contract.

## Deliverable (spec-property-retirement playbook, one PR)

For each of the three keys, in `packages/spec`:

1. `retiredKey()` tombstone (prescription sentence per the #6856 ruling: `to rewrite existing sources automatically.`);
2. protocol-17 conversion (all three are authorable page/component metadata — stored sources must convert; `RecordDetailsProps.layout` additionally had published `auto|custom` semantics that were never implemented, so its conversion is a pure strip);
3. ADR-0087 registry entries; regenerate baselines / forms / reference docs; liveness-ledger discipline per the playbook.

Precedent: #3809 (`PageCardProps.body`) — same objects, same shape.

## Sequencing

- objectui#3829 (drop the two parity-gate exemptions) and objectui#3818 (delete the `layout` input + the dead `inline|compact` branch) are **Blocked-by this card** and proceed on the next objectui pin bump after it lands.
- ⚠️ The ADR-0087 registry edits make the implementing PR **maintainer-merged only** per the standing `docs/adr/**` discipline — no auto-merge, no agent queue entry.

No `domain:*` applied — routing is the triage seat's. (Expected lane: `domain:spec`.)

Refs: objectui#3829, objectui#3818, #3809, ADR-0049, ADR-0087.
